channel.title: Playing Portraits
channel.desc: The trio composed of Alessandro Carbonare (clarinet), Elisa Eleonora Papandrea (violin) and Monaldo Braconi (piano) performs regularly in Italy's concert halls and abroad. Playing Portraits showcases the trio's appearances in various places, including USA, Russia and Europe, as they perform works by composers such as George Gershwin, Igor Stravinsky, Francis Poulenc, Anton Guilio Priolo, and Reiner Kuttenberger. This program was recorded by Pietro Tagliaferri at the Salle Belle Epoque in the National Gallery of Modern Art in Rome. Mit dabei: Elisa Eleonora Papandrea (Geige) Alessandro Carbonare (Klarinette) Monaldo Braconi (Klavier).
